invariants.statement: Two committed reservations for the same resource must not overlap.
Retrying an operation with the same idempotency key must not create a second reservation.
Equivalent timezone representations of the same instant must be treated as the same interval.
A failed reservation attempt must not leave a partial committed reservation.

handoff: Builder implements the approved model; Adversary targets every critical guarantee.
note: This artifact documents a local rehearsal and is not evidence of a BAND Desktop-generated stage.
